highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: Rolls up the entire v4 preview line through m132 to m148. Adds variable font support end-to-end, animated WebP encoding, zero-copy stream conversion, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from any 3.x version.

breaking.title: SKPaint text and font state-reading APIs are now compile errors
breaking.body: The paint text/font members obsoleted in v3 (`Typeface`, `TextSize`, `TextSkewX`, etc. read via SKPaint) are now errors in 4.x. Move typeface and text size configuration to SKFont. Pre-v4 obsoletes and enum aliases were also promoted to errors.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface — set one explicitly
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (zero glyphs); MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Construct with an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect 'unset' with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan terminates the process on Vulkan 1.0 — require 1.1
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 (upstream m139/m140). A Vulkan 1.0 instance no longer returns null — Skia calls SK_ABORT and the process terminates. Declare 1.1 in both VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion; leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 (the old default) is unsafe.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five legacy fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed from the interop struct. Delete those assignments. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, and fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo and lost value-equality
breaking.body: The Ycbcr conversion info struct follows the GR casing convention and no longer implements IEquatable or == / !=. Update the type name and any equality checks at the call site.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter on IgnorePublicDispose is removed. Subclasses that assigned to it must switch to constructor-time initialization or the overridable property pattern.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native stream offset is 32-bit. The long overload previously silently truncated large values; it now throws OverflowException on out-of-range input and carries [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) directly, clamping or validating the value first.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through m132, m133, and m147 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances from the 3.x Skia pin all the way to m148, picking up three years of upstream fixes. Several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix merges keep the engine stable.

SKObject singleton instances (contexts, surfaces created from external handles) are now tracked and disposed in a deterministic order, fixing races and double-dispose crashes seen with Ganesh and Graphite context teardown.
Default typeface lookup moves to the managed layer, fixing Android API 36+ crashes where the native path could return null. Every platform now guarantees a non-null SKTypeface.Default.

bullets.lead: Legacy font manager entry point restored
bullets.detail: The Skia shim regains sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface, restoring compatibility for downstream code relying on the legacy typeface factory.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color font palette support
bullets.detail: Variable font axes, instances, and named styles are exposed end-to-end through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. SKFont and SKTypeface gain color font palette selection and robust variable-font handling.
SKWebpEncoder can now emit animated WebP files from a frame sequence, closing the gap alongside the existing animated WebP decoder.
Turn any seekable stream into an SKData without an intermediate byte[] copy — useful when handing decoded assets to codecs, shaders, or external consumers.
New overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can choose mipmap and filter mode for surface-to-surface draws instead of accepting the implicit default.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzz wrappers
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp gets a proper HBColor value type matching hb_color_t, and fills in wrappers that had been missing or mis-named, moving toward full API coverage.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride (not Width × bpp) and the correct axis for the (x, y) offset, fixing silently-wrong pixel data on non-packed bitmaps.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: A GC ordering race that crashed the process during finalization when an SKPathBuilder was collected before the SKPath it produced is now fixed.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI no longer fails with a DLL-not-found error on .NET 9 WinAppSDK projects; the projection assembly is now resolved correctly.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView blank after MAUI TabBar switch
bullets.detail: Switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar no longer leaves SKGLView permanently blank; the GL surface is correctly re-attached when the view is re-added to the visual tree.

bullets.lead: Tizen picks up x64 and arm64 native builds
bullets.detail: Tizen ships alongside the existing x86/arm slices; consumers on 64-bit Tizen devices no longer fall back to emulation.
Android-hosted Linux (linux-bionic) is a first-class native target — the runtime identifier resolves to purpose-built binaries instead of the desktop glibc build.

bullets.lead: Apple TFMs aligned: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps
bullets.detail: Libraries target the versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) while sample apps use the unversioned ones, matching current .NET SDK guidance and unblocking MAUI-style consumers.

bullets.lead: WASM drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions
bullets.detail: .NET 8 is now the minimum for the SkiaSharp WASM native asset. Pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds are removed.
libexpat 2.7.5 and 2.8.1, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 all pick up their latest upstream security and bug fixes.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The Skia m132/m147 milestone bumps, variable font support end-to-end, the managed default-typeface fix, the SKPath/SKPathBuilder finalizer crash fix, and the singleton lifecycle rework.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Uno gallery and integration sample fixes.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switches on Android.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line: Skia m132 → m133 → m147, variable font and color palette support end-to-end, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws, managed default-typeface resolution, Tizen x64/arm64, Linux Bionic, and the PolySharp C# 13 shim.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer crash fix, Apple TFM alignment, and libexpat 2.7.5 / libpng 1.6.58 security refreshes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 delivered HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM Emscripten builds, and updated freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: RC 1 landed the Skia m148 engine bump, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint text/font promotion to compile errors, the SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride fix, the WinUI DLL resolution fix, the native-compat gate move to the SkiaApi constructor, expat 2.8.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates to HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with variable-font shaping and color font palette support wired end-to-end. Gains a proper HBColor value type for hb_color_t, and the singleton lifecycle rework improves disposal safety for long-lived shaping contexts.
